scenes.title_cn: 对比：普通实况 vs 博主实况
scenes.title_en: Compare: Your Live Photo vs. a Pro's
scenes.context: 这是你的实况图，这是百万博主的实况图。为什么你的怎么拍都普通，而人家的清晰且有质感？分享超好用的实况修图技巧。语域：修图教程，对比引入。
sentences: 这是你的实况图，这是百万博主的实况图。
This is your Live Photo; this is a million-follower creator's Live Photo.
million-follower creator（百万博主）
为什么你的怎么拍都普通？
Why do yours always turn out so plain?
turn out so plain（拍得普通）
而人家的清晰且有质感。
While theirs look crisp and textured.
crisp and textured（清晰有质感）
paraphrase: 实况图 → Live Photo / live shot
清晰有质感 → crisp and textured / sharp with depth
scenes.speak: This is your Live Photo; this is a million-follower creator's Live Photo. Why do yours always turn out so plain? While theirs look crisp and textured.

scenes.context: 导入实况图，找到涂鸦笔，选黑色，大小拉到82，随手画个圆球。语域：修图教程，参数口令。
sentences: 导入实况图，找到涂鸦笔。
Import the Live Photo and open the marker brush.
marker brush（涂鸦笔）
选黑色，大小拉到82。
Pick black and set the size to 82.
set the size to 82（大小拉到82）
随手画个圆球。
Just casually draw a round ball.
draw a round ball（画个圆球）
paraphrase: 涂鸦笔 → marker brush / doodle pen
随手画 → casually draw / freehand doodle
scenes.speak: Import the Live Photo and open the marker brush. Pick black and set the size to 82. Just casually draw a round ball.

scenes.title_en: Switch the Blend to Soft Light
scenes.context: 一不小心点到混合里的柔光，你看画面氛围感立刻上来了。混合模式柔光+黑色涂鸦=提升对比和氛围。语域：修图教程，效果演示。
sentences: 一不小心点到混合里的柔光。
Accidentally tap 'soft light' in the blend options.
soft light（柔光）
画面氛围感立刻上来了。
The mood of the frame instantly lifts.
the mood lifts（氛围感上来）
黑色打底加柔光，对比和质感都有了。
Black base plus soft light brings both contrast and texture.
contrast and texture（对比和质感）
paraphrase: 柔光 → soft light / soft-light blend
scenes.speak: Accidentally tap 'soft light' in the blend options. The mood of the frame instantly lifts. Black base plus soft light brings both contrast and texture.

scenes.context: 聪明的你，把圆球放大，铺满全屏。恭喜你，一不小心掌握了实况调色密码。语域：修图教程，轻松收尾。
sentences: 把圆球放大，铺满全屏。
Enlarge the ball and stretch it to fill the whole screen.
fill the whole screen（铺满全屏）
恭喜你，一不小心掌握了实况调色密码。
Congratulations — you've just unlocked the Live Photo grading code.
unlocked the grading code（掌握调色密码）
就这么简单，一张雾蒙蒙的照片变有质感。
That simple — a foggy photo turns textured.
a foggy photo（雾蒙蒙的照片）
paraphrase: 铺满全屏 → fill the screen / cover the frame
fill the screen · cover the frame
调色密码 → grading code / color secret
scenes.speak: Enlarge the ball and stretch it to fill the whole screen. Congratulations — you've just unlocked the Live Photo grading code. That simple — a foggy photo turns textured.

practice: Why do yours always turn out so plain, while theirs look crisp and textured?
Import the Live Photo, pick the black marker, and set the size to 82.
Tap 'soft light' in the blend options and the mood instantly lifts.
Enlarge the ball to fill the whole screen and unlock the grading code.
pitfalls: 「实况图」是 Live Photo，不是 living photo。
Open the marker brush and draw a round ball.
「涂鸦笔」用 marker brush / doodle pen。
Tap 'soft light' in the blend options.
「点到柔光」用 tap the soft light option。
A foggy photo turns textured after grading.
shifts: 用 marker brush（涂鸦笔）、soft light（柔光）、blend options（混合模式）
用 mood lifts（氛围感上来）、crisp and textured（清晰有质感）、contrast（对比）
用 plain（普通）、foggy（雾蒙蒙）、grading code（调色密码）
footer_notes: ASR 已校正：石矿图→实况图、协修→修图、涂鸦笔、混合里的柔光、调色密码、圆球、铺满全屏等。
